title: Wanderburg Demo — How to Play the Free Steam Demo
description: Wanderburg demo guide: Steam download, review score context, what the demo includes, FAQ, and how it relates to Early Access.

paragraphs: The free Wanderburg Demo is on Steam (app 4268810). Install it from the Steam store like any other free title — you do not need the paid Early Access app to try the demo.
Developer / festival messaging around Steam Next Fest said the demo would remain available for the foreseeable future. Always double-check the live store page if a festival page expires.
As captured in our 关卡3 research snapshot, the demo sat at Very Positive with roughly 91% positive from about 1,377 reviews — re-check Steam for live numbers.

sections.h2: What you can expect in the demo
paragraphs: Steam demo text matches the full game pitch: consume settlements, expand the fortress, mount cannons / wizard towers / explosives, and experiment with builds.
GameStar’s hands-on piece describes a “one more run” loop driven by castle driving physics and module combinations — expect learning the vehicle feel to take a few deaths.
Between-run unlock language on Steam (modules, vehicles, artifacts, captains) appears in the same product family. The demo is the safest place to feel that loop before spending money.
Full Early Access was scheduled for September 8, 2026 on Steam (app 3624140). Developers estimated about 6–12 months in EA, with more content and balance based on community feedback.
Use the demo to learn handling and early builds; expect systems and unlock pools to grow after EA. For schedule context see Release Date; for cost vs free confusion see Price.
If you only need cinematic context before downloading, watch the official reveal trailer linked on our Trailer page.

Steam positions Wanderburg as friendly to modest PCs (“ready for potato”) with playable mouse, keyboard, or controller support. Live Minimum / Recommended rows can change — trust the Steam system requirements panel.
Our System Requirements page summarizes that positioning without inventing FPS benchmarks. Steam Deck Verified status was not confirmed in research; treat Deck play as community-tested.

Do I keep demo progress into EA? Official store pages we reviewed did not promise a full save migration story — assume demo practice is for skill, not permanent inventory, until Randwerk says otherwise.
Is the demo the full game? No. It is a free trial slice. Paid EA is the growing product.
Where do I ask questions? Official Discord (linked from Steam) and Steam discussions are the correct channels for bug reports; this fan wiki cannot replace them.
Run 2–3 short attempts focusing only on drifting and not dying to swarms.
Then read the Beginner Guide and Tips pages, and try the sustain-first package on Best Build.
When you are ready to buy or wait: Release Date + Price + the main Steam store page.

sources: Steam Next Fest / developer demo availability notes from 关卡3
